01 — Brand story

Why we exist

Content Decoded helps entrepreneurs scale and sell on social — turning content into a system, not a guessing game.

What we do

Social media management for founders and businesses who know content matters but don't have the time, team, or process to do it well. Research, ideation, scripting, filming guidance, editing, and monthly performance analysis — end to end.

How we say it

Direct. Confident. No fluff. Every piece of copy — from a bio to a proposal — should sound like someone who has actually done the work, not an agency reciting buzzwords.

Helping entrepreneurs scale and sell on social Social Media Management Work with us
02 — Logo system

One mark, two contexts

Toggle the background below to see how the primary lockup adapts to light and dark surroundings.

The wordmark's gold and cream tones read poorly on white — on light layouts, always keep it inside its own dark maroon backing, never floating directly on a light page.

Icon / App Mark
CD Monogram
Wordmark Only

Clear space

Keep at least one icon-width of clear space around the mark on every side — nothing crowds it: no text, no edge, no competing graphic.

1X 1X

Misuse

  • Don't recolor the gold gradient to a flat color.
  • Don't stretch or squash the lockup off its aspect ratio.
  • Don't place the wordmark on busy photography without a solid or gradient backing.
  • Don't add extra drop shadows, outlines, or bevels beyond the approved shadow variant.

Usage ratio

Aim for roughly 60% maroon, 30% cream/neutral, 10% gold across any single layout. Gold is a highlight, not a background — reserve it for the logo, key numbers, and calls to action so it keeps its impact.

04 — Typography

Two typefaces, clear roles

Beckman Free carries the brand's voice in headlines and titles. Quarzo is reserved for short, punchy moments — stats, mantras, callouts.

Primary · Display & Headlines
Content Decoded
Beckman FreeUse for: H1–H3, cover titles, section banners
Accent · Stats, mantras, short emphasis
Content. Convert. Compound.
QuarzoUse for: pull-quotes, big numbers, one-line mantras — never body copy
Body copy

Long-form text — proposals, guides, captions — uses a clean neutral sans (Arial/system default) instead of the display faces. Beckman and Quarzo are built for short, bold moments; at paragraph length they lose readability, so body copy stays in a plain, highly legible font.

Type scale

H1Aa Content
H2Aa Content
H3Aa Content
BodyAa Content — regular paragraph text
05 — Voice & tone

How Content Decoded sounds

Straight from the brand's own Instagram bio — this is the tone every caption, proposal, and DM should match.

“Content · Convert · Compound”
Say this
  • Helping entrepreneurs scale and sell on social.
  • Work with us.
  • Here's the exact process.
  • Short sentences. Direct claims. Real numbers.
Not this
  • We leverage synergistic content solutions.
  • Reach out to learn more!!!
  • Vague promises with no specifics.
  • Corporate-speak, excessive exclamation points.
06 — Imagery & backgrounds

Dark, textured, and warm

Cover pages and hero moments use a maroon-to-black gradient with a fine diagonal grain texture — never a flat, untextured fill.

Cover / hero gradient + grain texture
Founder photography — maroon backdrop, natural light

Guidelines

Founder and team photography sits on a solid maroon backdrop, lit naturally, no heavy filters. Screenshots and product visuals get a light drop shadow and rounded corners to match the icon's own corner radius — never square-cropped with hard edges.

07 — Do's & don'ts

Quick gut-check

Tap any card to expand it.

Do
Keep gold as a highlight
Use gold for the logo, key numbers, and one clear call to action per layout — not as a background fill.
Don't
Flatten the gold gradient
The gold in the logo is a gradient, not a flat swatch — recoloring it flat loses the dimension that makes the mark feel premium.
Do
Write like a person
Short, direct sentences with real specifics — dates, numbers, exact process steps — beat vague marketing language every time.
Don't
Crowd the logo
Always keep at least one icon-width of clear space around the mark — no text, edges, or other graphics inside that zone.
08 — Quick reference

Grab the tokens

For anyone building a deck, doc, or webpage — copy these values straight into your project.

:root { --cd-maroon: #460202; --cd-gold-light: #F3D58F; --cd-gold-accent: #B9862E; --cd-font-display: 'Beckman Free', Georgia, serif; --cd-font-accent: 'Quarzo', Georgia, serif; --cd-font-body: Arial, sans-serif; }
